subject: Knight Animation Attempt 1
object: Hunyuan3D GLB is single fused sculpture mesh, no separate parts, no UVs, no materials

subject: Knight Animation Attempt 2
object: UniRig auto-rigging produced 35-bone skeleton with weights, but fused mesh still distorts

subject: Knight Animation Attempt 4
object: Raw bmesh vertex coordinates produce disconnected blobs, not viable for humanoid modeling

subject: Knight Animation Attempt 6
object: Skin modifier body + Rigify 29-bone metarig + BONE-parented accessories (sword/shield/helmet)

subject: Blender BONE Parenting
object: Object origin placed at bone TAIL not HEAD. Always offset by bone.head_local - bone.tail_local

subject: Blender ARMATURE_AUTO
object: Deformable body meshes. NEVER for rigid accessories (sword/shield/helmet) — they warp and fly off

subject: Blender matrix_parent_inverse
object: bpy.ops.object.parent_set operator BUT NOT by direct property assignment (obj.parent_type='BONE')

subject: Knight Blend Files
object: /tmp/knight_*.blend on dev server 176.9.99.103, best version is knight_final_v2.blend

subject: Cinematic Pingpong Fix
object: SVD-XT two-batch forward-only generation (no split/reverse/concat), minterpolate to 24fps

subject: DenizenReveal Component
object: ?v=N query parameter on video src URLs, increment N on each deploy

subject: Professional 3D Character Pipeline
object: Separate mesh parts (body/sword/shield), proper UV unwraps, pre-made skeleton, weight painting, PBR materials

subject: Why AI Cannot Match Professional 3D Artist
object: No real-time visual feedback, must iterate via blind code->render->inspect cycle, and tends to make 20 changes at once instead of one-at-a-time debugging
